questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{建立如图所示的直角坐标系，}\\&\text{依题意，}OA\text{所在直线方程为}y=3x\text{选取}y\text{为积分变量，则}y\in[0,3]\text{.取}[y,y+dy]\subset[0,3]\text{,}\\&\text{将}[y,y+dy]\text{的一层水吸出去，其水质量近似为}20\times\frac{2}{3}y\rho dy,\text{提升高度为}(3-y)\text{.于是，功}\\&\text{元素为}\\&dW=\frac{40}{3}\rho gy(3-y)dy,\quad\\&\text{需做的功为}\\&W=\int_{0}^{3}\frac{40}{3}\rho gy(3-y)dy=\frac{40}{3}\rho g\left[\frac{3}{2}y^{2}-\frac{1}{3}y^{3}\right]_{0}^{3}\\&=60\rho g=5.88\times 10^{5}\left(J\right).\end{aligned}

options.label: A

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解：气体膨胀为等温过程，所以气体压强为} & P=\frac{C}{V}, (V--\text{气体体积}，C--\text{常数})， \\ \text{而活塞上的总压力为} & F=PQ=\frac{CQ}{V}=\frac{C}{S}. \\ & (Q--\text{活塞的截面积}，S\text{为活塞移动的距离}，V=SQ)，\text{以} S_1 \text{与} S_2 \text{表示活塞的初始与终止位置}，\text{于是得功为} \\ & W=\int_{S_1}^{S_2} FdS=C\int_{S_1}^{S_2}\frac{1}{S}dS \\ &= C\int_{V_1}^{V_2}\frac{1}{V}dV \\ &= C\ln V|_{V_1}^{V_2}=C\ln \frac{V_2}{V_1}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{解：设击入木板的深度为}x\,\text{cm，所受的力}F=kx,\text{在}[0,1]\text{中取区间}[x,\,x+dx],\text{所做的微功}dw=kxdx,\,w_1=\int_0^1 dw=\int_1^1 kxdx=0.5\,k,\text{设第二次击入木板}h\,\text{cm，在}[1,1+h]\text{上用微元法，则}w_2=\int_1^{1+h} kxdx=0.5k\left[(1+h)^2-1\right].\text{由}w_1=w_2,\text{得}h=\sqrt{2}-1.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解：将池中深度为 } x \text{ 到 } x+\Delta x \text{ 的一薄层水抽到池口所做的功 } W \text{ 的微元为 } dW=\rho g x dV \text{ 而 } dV=\pi [15(1-\frac{x}{10})]^2 dx \text{，因此 } dW=\pi \rho g x [15(1-\frac{x}{10})]^2 dx \text{，于是求得 } W=225 \pi v \int_{0}^{10} x (1-\frac{x}{10})^2 \, dx =1875 \pi \rho g (J).\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解：} \ W_{i} \text {为第} i \text {次锤击作的功.} W_{1} = \int_{0}^{1} kx dx = \frac{k}{2}, \ W_{n} = \int_{0}^{h} kx dx = \frac{kh^{2}}{2}, \text {由} W_{n} = nh_{i}, \text {得} \\ h = \sqrt{n}, \text {第} n \text {次锤击时，击入的深度为} \sqrt{n} - \sqrt{n-1} (\text {cm}). \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} &dW_1=(\rho-\rho_0)g\pi y^2dx\cdot(H-R+x)\\ &=(\rho-\rho_0)g\pi(R^2-x^2)(H-R+x)dx\\ &\text{提出水面后的功元素为}\\ &dW_2=\rho g\pi y^2dx\cdot(R-x)\\ &=\rho g\pi(R^2-x^2)(R-x)dx\\ &\text{因此功元素为}\\ &dW=dW_1+dW_2\\ &=g\pi\int_{-R}^R\left[(\rho-\rho_0)H+\rho_0(R-x)\right]\!\left(R^2-x^2\right)dx\\ &\downarrow\text{“偶倍奇零”}\\ &=2g\pi\left[(\rho-\rho_0)H+\rho_0R\right]\!\int_0^R\!\left(R^2-x^2\right)dx\\ &=\frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\left[(\rho-\rho_0)H+\rho_0R\right]g \end{aligned}
